path.data-subject-role: Upper cloud-base reference, not a complete parent cloud silhouette or a physical ceiling. Selected visible air-column boundary connects exactly here.
Lower ground reference, with both column boundary endpoints actually joining it. Not a detached funnel cloud or calibrated damage/ground-contact footprint.
Left selected visible-condensation boundary around rotating air; joins cloud base and ground. Not a solid wall or universal tornado morphology.
Right selected visible-condensation boundary around rotating air; joins cloud base and ground. Actual condensation visibility and diameter can vary; this is one grounded example.

Detached curved rotation convention inside the selected column. Native screen angles pi→2pi run left→upper→right, tangent downward at the tip; not a measured in-plane wind vector, trajectory or hemisphere rule.
Open direction-head leg of the SAME schematic curved rotation cue, not another column, wind vector, force or letter glyph.
Open direction-head leg of the SAME schematic curved rotation cue, not another column, wind vector, force or letter glyph.
